sources.extracted_facts: Spykar is an India-focused denim-led youth brand. Its blog rules require Indian English, practical fit and styling detail, natural unbolded keywords, restrained claims, a soft CTA, the canonical native Google Doc format and a unique 4:3 banner.
Requested topic: 5 Denim Looks to Wear for Ganesh Chaturthi Celebrations.

Live SERP review covered RangRaze at 1,628 words, Style Junkiie at 870 words and Diwas at 1,852 words. Common patterns were occasion-led outfit selection, comfort, festive colour and accessories. The target was set at roughly 1,700-1,900 words with a practical five-look structure and a clearer denim/fusion angle.

Spykar already has Raksha Bandhan smart-casual sibling styling, Independence Day denim styling and broader festive/every-plan articles. None of the reviewed local or indexed content targets five Ganesh Chaturthi denim looks.
